issues: transform scale(3.2) 按 1x 栅格化再放大，开场透视窄带里的字与行全是锯齿碎块（Q2）
抬头三段关键帧各自 out-cubic，每段起点都是最大速度：f25 从静止瞬间满速起跳、f68/f72 两处速度突变
背景是死平的 G.bg 灰，平躺与回正时页面受光完全一样，没有纸面材质与空间感
开场 25f 俯角定格完全静止，没有导出时长常量（工作台按 150f 猜）
changes: 放大改走 CSS zoom 布局栅格化，并把 scale(s)·rotateX(r) 等价换算为 rotateX(r′)·scaleY(k)（tan r′=tan r/s），投影与原式一致而字是原生分辨率
平躺时按纵向压缩比做只竖向的高斯预滤波（σ≈0.55/压缩比×1.6，抬到可读前自动关），消除窄带锯齿闪烁
主抬升改单条 EASE.swift（零速起步、中段快）到 f68 正好停在 +2.6° 过冲顶点，再 smooth 8f 回 0°；定格段加 -80°→-77° 极缓 creep
Backdrop 柔光背景 + 暗角 + 颗粒替代平灰；纸面随俯角受光（平躺压暗、远端薄雾），图纸带随高度变化的两层软影；抬头最快段给竖向 SpeedBlur
补导出 TILT_REVEAL_DURATION = 145（76f 动作 + 69f 真静止）
issuesEn: transform scale(3.2) rasterises at 1x then magnifies, so text and rows in the opening perspective strip are jagged fragments (Q2)
The three tilt keyframe segments each use out-cubic, so every segment starts at full speed: a jump from rest at f25 and velocity breaks at f68/f72
The background is a dead flat G.bg grey, and the page is lit identically lying flat and upright, with no paper material or sense of space
The 25-frame opening hold is completely static, and no duration constant was exported (the workbench guessed 150f)
changesEn: Magnification now uses CSS zoom layout rasterisation, with scale(s)·rotateX(r) rewritten as the equivalent rotateX(r′)·scaleY(k) (tan r′ = tan r/s): identical projection, native-resolution text
While lying flat, a vertical-only Gaussian prefilter scaled to the vertical compression (σ≈0.55/compression×1.6, off before the text becomes readable) removes strip aliasing and shimmer
The main tilt is one EASE.swift curve (zero-velocity start, fast middle) that stops exactly at the +2.6° overshoot at f68, then an 8-frame smooth return to 0°; the hold gets a gentle -80°→-77° creep

A Backdrop with soft light, vignette and grain replaces the flat grey; the page's lighting follows the tilt (darker when flat, haze at the far edge), it casts a height-dependent two-layer soft shadow, and the fastest frames get vertical SpeedBlur
Exported TILT_REVEAL_DURATION = 145 (76f of motion + 69f true hold)
